text:
maya: Quick report from tonight's reranker PTQ pass — new quant recipe (awq-perhead) on rbrk-v2-small shows suspicious MRR cliff for single-token queries. Plot attached in artifacts but TL;DR below.

sam: Can you paste the exact eval command and flags?

maya: `./ci/eval_rerank.py --split webqa-holdout --model rbrk-v2-small --quant awq-perhead --cfg quant.yml --batch 256 --seed 7`

maya: Aggregate: overall ndcg@10 only down 3%, but qlen=1 mrr drops from 0.62 -> 0.30. qlen=2 drops 0.58 -> 0.49.

omar: That asymmetry screams tokenization/priming alignment or KV packing mismatch. Did runtime change?

maya: Yes we switched to runtime-vnext w/ kvpack-v3 for better throughput.

lee: Any diffs in logits distribution for first token? Run `score_stats --slice qlen==1` and paste min/mean/max logits for top candidate.

maya: Ran quick: `top_logit_mean_fp16=3.2, int8=1.1; top_logit_std_fp16=0.9, int8=1.8` — int8 has much higher variance and lower mean.

sam: High variance + mean shift explains rank flips. Do pairwise flip-rate between fp16 and int8 for qlen=1.

maya: Flip-rate = 0.42 on 1500 sampled queries. For qlen>2 flip-rate ~0.09.

omar: Can you dump tokenized inputs for a few high-flip queries? We need to check priming tokens and any special markers.

maya: Example 1: `query: "numpy" -> tokens [812, 5]` priming string used is `"Query: "` (2 tokens). Concat order: priming + query.

lee: If kv offsets are computed using sequence-length buckets and a bug treats seqlen==2 as empty segment, the KV read can be garbage for first layers. That would hurt short seqs.

sam: Try two quick experiments: 1) run awq-perhead but use runtime-vprev (kvpack-v2) 2) run awq-global (no per-head scales) on runtime-vnext. Which one recovers?

maya: Kicking both. CI: @ci-bot started jobs rerank/2200001234-a (vprev-awq-perhead) and rerank/2200001234-b (vnext-awq-global)

ci-bot: Job rerank/2200001234-a queued. Job rerank/2200001234-b queued.

ci-bot: Job rerank/2200001234-a finished. Results: qlen=1 mrr=0.60 (fp16 ~0.62). Overall delta negligible.

ci-bot: Job rerank/2200001234-b finished. Results: qlen=1 mrr=0.34. Slight improvement but still bad.

sam: So runtime switch fixes it, global scales only marginally helps. Root cause looks like awq-perhead interacting with kvpack-v3.

omar: I'll repro locally with small model and attach a mem-dump of kv tensors to GH issue. If kv offsets are misaligned by head-block that's plausible.

lee: Meanwhile can we add a quick CI guard: when onboarding quantized models, compute qlen-sliced ndcg/mrr and require qlen=1/2 to be within X% of fp16. Save the plot artifact.

maya: Agreed. I'll add a note in onboarding checklist and pin runtime to kvpack-v2 for tonight's canary.

sam: Action items: omar -> runtime triage + unit test for zero/short-seq kvpack offsets (owner: omar). lee -> run small sweep toggling per-head clip threshold (owner: lee). maya -> add qlen slices to eval CI and pin runtime for canary (owner: maya).

omar: Created issue redwood/runtime#1267 with repro script `tests/kvpack_shortseq_repro.py` and sample dumps.

maya: One more datapoint: pad-to-length-6 workaround on client side recovers qlen=1 mrr to 0.59. So we can also ship software-side pad until runtime is fixed.

sam: Good pragmatic plan. Add that to canary notes in /docs/rerank_onboard.md.

lee: I'll post sweep results tomorrow AM.

maya: Thanks all. Note: short-query slices are small but high-impact; adding them to CI will save future head-scratches. :+1:
